set.text: Reading diagnostics. Ordinary T roofs are not added bars; the first dotted T_i, the T in (14), and the lower dotted T have substantial body or roof overwork without a recoverable prior glyph. The tiny point after the first T in the P04 parenthesis is retained explicitly after root inspection, with a T_i alternative. Its mathematical role remains unassigned; the earlier dismissal as a pen remnant is withdrawn. The darker group below main implique is the live à in the diagonal note, not a separate cancelled main word. The insertion leader of (globalement) is not an underline of équisingulier le long de Y. Both written cônique occurrences have a separate arch over o. The main grammar “on dit / il est” is left as written, without supplying qu’. The open intervals, source phi, underlined ou and written equals-sign shorthand are retained exactly.

notes.text: Independent audit: root inspected all 14 nonidentical boxes, the completed diagonal-note crop and a wider native context separating marginal strokes from main prose. Four boxes were revised. The detached point in the family formula is now transcribed with an index alternative; three other revisions add local uncertainty without changing their preferred readings. The immutable first/second readings are preserved.
